headings.rules: Never center by default. Use tracking-tight. Max text-6xl. Break the generic font mold.

mono.usage: Use exclusively for OSINT data, bot commands, IPs, and analytical stats.

colors.rules: No standard gradients. Rely on true blacks and dark navys. Accent colors should be used for status, progress, and 1px borders. Text must meet APCA contrast minimums.

landing_page.hero: Dark overlay (bg-black/50 maximum). Technical typography. Left-aligned text.

admin_dashboard.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px border (border-white/10). No soft shadows.

rtl_guidelines.rule_1: CRITICAL: Use Tailwind logical properties exclusively: ps-4, pe-4, ms-2, me-2, ms-auto instead of pl-4, pr-4, ml-2, mr-2, ml-auto.
rtl_guidelines.rule_2: Use text-start and text-end instead of text-left and text-right.
rtl_guidelines.rule_4: Use rounded-s-md, rounded-e-md instead of rounded-l-md, rounded-r-md.
rtl_guidelines.rule_5: Ensure directional icons (like arrows) are flipped when dir='rtl' using rtl:-scale-x-100.

surfaces.cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look). border-r border-b on grid items. Flat backgrounds.
surfaces.headers: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px bottom border border-white/10. NO purely transparent backgrounds.
surfaces.effects: Use 'Tracing Beam' style glowing animated borders for the Elite/Pro Pricing tiers.

motion.rules: Subtle entrance animations. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Don't use transition-all. Use specific properties like transition-transform or transition-opacity.

visual_enhancers.backgrounds: Use subtle grain/noise CSS overlays (opacity 3-5%) over solid dark colors to create depth.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Heavy use of 1px borders (border-border) to define layout sections. Add 'border-collapse' logic.

image_urls.description: Hacker hands typing in dark (Use with bg-black/50 overlay)
Blue data dots and network lines

component_guidelines.general: Use Shadcn components but strip standard Vercel soft-look. Customize them for an Elite Security terminal vibe (sharp corners, high contrast).
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Hover state must increase brightness and show 1px cyan/red border.
component_guidelines.tables: Dense. JetBrains Mono for data columns. Status dots for active/inactive.
component_guidelines.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid to all interactive elements, links, and forms.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
This is a JS project, strictly use .js/.jsx files, not .tsx files.
Implement a language toggler that switches document.dir to 'rtl' for Arabic, 'ltr' for English. Layout MUST adjust automatically via logical Tailwind properties.
NEVER use generic placeholder text or dummy image URLs.
For the admin dashboard, ensure a high-density, cardless design. Rely on borders instead of shadows.
Apply 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)' layout to the pricing and features section.
Use lucide-react for sharp technical iconography.
Do NOT center align the app container.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds over content or headers. Use Crystal Glassmorphism instead.
Add 'data-testid' to all critical interactions (buttons, links, form inputs).
